The road to WWE SummerSlam leads to Minnesota. The company’s epic two-night summer spectacle has wrestling fans, celebrities and musicians flocking to witness a jam-packed wrestling cards and the resolution of shocking storylines.

The lineups for SummerSlam are split between two nights. For night one, there are six matches, headlined with Liv Morgan defending her Women’s World Championship title against Iyo Sky. And for night two, there’s six matches scheduled Roman Reigns defending his World Heavyweight Championship title belt against Seth Rollins.

Watch on DirectV

When and Where Is WWE SummerSlam 2026?

SummerSlam kicks off on Saturday (Aug. 1) and Sunday (Aug. 2), beginning at 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT each night. The two-night event takes place at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

Who’s Performing During WWE SummerSlam 2026?

While there’s no word on who will perform for night one, Grammy Award-winner Darius Rucker, who is a longtime WWE fan, is set to perform “The Star-Spangled Banner” to open SummerSlam on night two.

What’s the Match Card for WWE SummerSlam 2026?

Over two nights, there are 12 matches (six matches each night) for SummerSlam. The main event for night one is Liv Morgan vs. Iyo Sky, while the main event for night two is Roman Reigns vs. Seth Rollins.

Night 1 Match Card (Saturday, Aug. 1, 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT):

- Women’s World Championship: Liv Morgan (champion) vs. Iyo Sky

- Hell in a Cell: Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi

- Undisputed WWE Championship: CM Punk (champion) vs. Cody Rhodes

- Six-Man Tag Team: LA Knight, Royce Keys, and Solo Sikoa vs. The Bloodline

- Gunther vs. Nick Aldis

- Six-Woman Tag Team: The Bella Twins and Paige vs. Fatal Influence

Night 2 Match Card (Sunday, Aug. 2, 7 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT):

- World Heavyweight Championship: Roman Reigns (champion) vs. Seth Rollins

- WWE Intercontinental Championship: Penta (champion) vs. Chad Gable

- Interim WWE Women’s Championship (Ladder Match): Charlotte Flair vs. Chelsea Green vs. Jade Cargill vs. Tiffany Stratton vs. Giulia (or Lash Legend)

- Danhausen vs. Dominik Mysterio

- Finn Bálor vs. Sami Zayn

- WWE United States Championship: Trick Williams (champion) vs. Baron Corbin
